31:   const relative = path.relative(contentDir, filePath);
32:   const withoutExt = relative.replace(MARKDOWN_EXT, '');
33:   return withoutExt.split(path.sep).join('/');
34: }

37:   if (data.title && data.title.trim()) {

41:   return segments[segments.length - 1] ?? slug;

47:       tags: data.tags,
